name: Cybersecurity Homelab
desc: My seven-VM company network on Proxmox. It runs pfSense, Kali, Metasploitable, DVWA/WebGoat, a Windows Server 2022 AD domain and Security Onion.

name: Enterprise IT Support Lab
desc: A Windows domain for practicing support work: Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell, NTFS permissions and an osTicket help desk where I work realistic tickets.

name: wg2 RAT Teardown
desc: I took apart an HTTP RAT in Ghidra and annotated the whole decompilation. It uses bit-shift C2 obfuscation, bypasses SSL certificate errors, has an 11-command protocol and steals tokens to escalate privileges.

name: SQL Slammer Worm Teardown
desc: A commented disassembly and stack-layout study of a 376-byte UDP worm. It gets in through a stack overflow, builds its API strings on the stack, makes random IPs with only lea and shifts, and spreads in a sendto() loop.

name: Malware Analysis Labs
desc: I reverse-engineered a RAT and a SQL worm in IDA Pro and Ghidra, and patched out SIDT/SLDT/STR anti-VM checks.

name: HiTek Digital Forensics Challenge
desc: Team investigation of an insider data exfiltration. We cracked six accounts, carved deleted ZIPs out of unallocated space and rebuilt the FTP-to-HTTP exfil chain from two disk images and a PCAP.

name: ERU
desc: Team social media app with a Spring Boot + MongoDB backend and a React Native (Expo) frontend. It has a feed, uploads, comments, likes and profiles.

name: Room'r
desc: Swipe-style roommate matching app. It has a lifestyle questionnaire, a weighted compatibility score, dealbreakers that work both ways, chat with icebreakers and push notifications.

name: Supermarket DBMS
desc: Multi-branch supermarket database in SQLite. It has a normalized schema, transactional checkout, 16 named reports and a Python CLI.

name: JavaShooter
desc: My first game: an infinite roguelike shooter in Java with chaser enemies, bosses and level-up upgrades. The source is on GitHub and the lessons are in the write-up.
